emails.subject: 2026 Summer Internship Program — Applications Open
emails.raw:
Subject: 2026 Summer Internship Program — Applications Open
From: careers@acme.com

We are excited to announce our 10-week Summer Internship Program for Software Engineering.

Apply by: May 10, 2026
Eligibility: BSCS/SE students in 5th semester or above.
Required: CV, transcript, GitHub/portfolio link.
Apply here: https://acme.com/internships/apply

emails.subject: AI Research Fellowship — Fully Funded

Subject: AI Research Fellowship — Fully Funded
From: fellowships@researchlab.org

We invite applications for a fully funded AI research fellowship.
Apply by: June 15, 2026
Requirements: Python, ML basics, ability to commit 10 hrs/week.
Benefits: Stipend, mentorship, certificate.
Apply: https://researchlab.org/fellowship/apply
